footprint.symmetry: approximate bilateral symmetry along the central front-back axis

repeated_patterns: Place full-width glass window rows on both floors: long horizontal strips with stonebrick corner columns; leave a central recessed opening for the entrance on the lower floor.
raw_elements: continuous horizontal window bands on first and second levels across front and sides
centered recessed entrance/porch projecting from front midline with slab steps
multi-tiered stacked slab roof (concentric smaller slabs toward center)
glowstone blocks inset near front lower corners
raw_hints: Start with a rectangular cobblestone base roughly 15x25 blocks (outer edge visible) then build two stacked wooden-plank stories centered on that base.
Place full-width glass window rows on both floors: long horizontal strips with stonebrick corner columns; leave a central recessed opening for the entrance on the lower floor.
Cap each story near the top edges with a ring of stone slabs forming small overhangs; stack decreasing-size layers of stone slabs centered on the roof to form the stepped pyramid.
Add glowstone at lower front corners embedded between wood and cobblestone for lighting; use slab_stone for the porch/steps projecting from the center front.
rebuild_intent.summary: A small two-level rectangular house with stepped stone-slab roof. Walls are mainly horizontal wooden planks with a cobblestone base and stonebrick/stone slab accents; windows run across the front and sides and glowstone is used near corners. The roof consists of stacked stone slabs forming a tiered pyramid above the center of the footprint. A centered protruding entrance/porch is visible on the front midline.
